nodes.summary: Let $(F_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be a sequence of functions $\mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ that is locally uniformly bounded on $U \subseteq \mathbb{C}$. Then for every compact set $K \subseteq U$ there is a real $C \ge 0$ with $|F_n(y)| \le C$ for all $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and all $y \in K$.
nodes.title: Locally uniformly bounded sequences are uniformly bounded on compact subsets

nodes.summary: Let $U \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ be open, let $(F_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be a sequence of functions $\mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ and let $C \ge 0$ be real. If $|F_n(y)| \le C$ for all $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and all $y \in U$, then $(F_n)$ is locally uniformly bounded on $U$.
nodes.title: A uniformly bounded sequence on an open set is locally uniformly bounded

nodes.summary: Let $U \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ and let $(F_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be a sequence of functions $\mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$. The sequence is locally uniformly bounded on $U$ when every $x \in U$ has an open neighbourhood $V \subseteq U$ and a real $C \ge 0$ such that $|F_n(y)| \le C$ for all $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and all $y \in V$.
nodes.title: Locally uniformly bounded sequence of functions

nodes.summary: Let $U \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ be open and let $(F_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be a sequence of functions $\mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$, each holomorphic on $U$, that is locally uniformly bounded on $U$. Then there are a strictly increasing map $\varphi : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and a function $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$, holomorphic on $U$, such that $F_{\varphi(n)} \to f$ locally uniformly on $U$ as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Montel's theorem

nodes.summary: Let $U \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ be open and preconnected, and let $(F_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be a sequence of functions $\mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$, each holomorphic on $U$, that is locally uniformly bounded on $U$. nodes.title: Vitali's convergence theorem

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
